Artist Note:
This comic is old, and even though I know you guys will love it, I hated it. The English is probably a bit weird, but I don't want to touch it anymore. The reason is simple: it was supposed to be a cute comedy, but it turned into a massive porn. That’s what happens when you shelve projects for too long until you get a depressive episode. I tried to finish it, but the art style is outdated and it’s taking time away from my current projects. Thank you for your support everyone. Hugs!!!
